title: Instrumentl Summer Launch: Your Strategic Prospecting Partner
summary: Instrumentl Discover is your intelligent prospecting partner—it tunes to your program priorities, responds to your feedback, and sharpens your matches as it learns your strategy.
body_markdown:
In 2026, grant professionals are being asked to do more. So we are doing more for grant professionals.


11 years ago, when we started Instrumentl, grant professionals spent more time hunting for opportunities than pursuing them. We saw the problem and built matching: the right grants surfaced in minutes, with funder context built in. It became how modern grant teams prospect.


**But a match is no longer enough.**


Because a grant team's real job isn't finding an opportunity — it's building a grants strategy. It's understanding the full funding landscape well enough to make confident calls about where to invest the organization's time, what to walk away from, and what to wait on.


And it's work that's getting harder to do. With new restrictions on federal funds, private funders going "invite only," and AI shifting how grants are found and won, grant professionals are being asked to "do more with less" and "stay on top of it all" — at the exact moment when the landscape feels least predictable.


In this new moment, grant teams need a tool that operates as a strategic partner. One that promises to:


- **Leave no stone unturned.** Giving you confidence that no opportunity worth your attention is ever missed.
- **Act intelligently.** A sharp filter through the noise — tuned to your specific program priorities, responding to your feedback, getting better as it learns your strategy.
- **Work while you sleep.** Researching in the background, always scouring for the next good fit, so new opportunities find you before you even log on.


This summer, we've built that strategic partner.


[Try it for free with a 14-day trial](https://www.instrumentl.com/signup?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch-blog-post&utm_campaign=summer-launch)


‍


‍


## Introducing the new Instrumentl Discover


Instrumentl Discover is now your intelligent prospecting partner, built to find every fit, cut through the noise, and keep you one step ahead.


It starts with what has always set Instrumentl apart: The most comprehensive funding database in grants, built over a decade and maintained by a team of human grant experts. 34,000+ active, validated opportunities. A complete giving history for every funder. Updated daily — including state government grants most databases miss entirely.


Now, we’ve improved how you interact with it.


‍


‍


**Describe your program like you’re speaking with a colleague, not a search engine.** Released last year, our Prospecting Assistant allows you to describe what you’re funding in your own words. It’ll work to understand your program, and give you relevant grant opportunities based on that more complex understanding.


(For example: If you ask about “sourdough” — it’ll also look for opportunities that involve “baking” or “bread” or “wild yeasts”).


But a “relevant” grant isn’t always the “right” grant. You still have to layer in your organization’s specific priorities, the preferences you’ve developed from past wins — all that criteria that’s specific to *your* unique funding strategy.


Now, for the first time you can.


With the new Instrumentl Discover, you can keep chatting with your matches, and bring the best fits into focus. Maybe you only want to see grants that will fund operational costs. Maybe you prefer multi-year funding. Maybe you want grants that specifically fund your county but aren’t open to your entire state, or maybe you want to eliminate grants that are invite-only.


Instead of opening a hundred tabs and handpicking the grants that work, you tell the Prospecting Assistant more about your fundraising strategy. And you’ll get a curated list of opportunities that are specific to your organization’s goals.


‍


‍


**See the "why" behind every recommendation.** We’re making it easy to tell *which* of those opportunities are right with **match insights** on the results page. Funder history, geographic focus, and eligibility nuance. All at a glance— so you know what to prioritize, and what to tell the Prospecting Assistant to filter away.


‍


**New opportunities find you.** Once you’re all set up to see only the grants that fit your strategy — you never have to rebuild a search. New opportunities that meet your criteria find you. Our team of grant experts curates and confirms new opportunities daily. And as we add new grants to Instrumentl's database, your matches update automatically. New, finely-tuned, grants are surfaced while you sleep.


‍


‍


**Work in Instrumentl — or in Claude.** Now, you can work with your Instrumentl grants in Claude via our Claude Connector. Browse matches, save opportunities, take notes, and hide poor fits without context-switching. Every action syncs back to Instrumentl automatically. It's the same trusted data, with a different front door. ([More on how to set up our Claude Connector here](https://instrumentl.com/blog/instrumentl-claude-connector) ).


‍


#### **How to get started**


The new Discover experience is available now to Instrumentl customers on most plans: Standard (Legacy), Pro (Legacy), Advanced (Legacy), Discover, Pre-Award, Full-Lifecycle, Enterprise, and University.


To try it, start a new project, then opt-into the new Discover experience.


‍


Not an Instrumentl customer yet? You can try the new experience for free by[starting a 14-day free trial](https://www.instrumentl.com/signup?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch-blog-post&utm_campaign=summer-launch) **.**


## Coming Soon: Reporting upgrades and Instrumentl Academy


Coming later this year, expect **major upgrades to your tracking and reporting experience** so that you can truly operate your grants program from one place.


We know grant teams are piecing together their portfolio picture manually: spreadsheets, calendars, email threads, financial systems, and Instrumentl, all reconciled by hand. We’re re-building Instrumentl so your full portfolio can live in one place — what's in flight, submitted, awarded, and spent.


Filter your tracker by criteria like team member, owner, program, grant status, or time window. Or chat with your assistant to see something more specific, like:


- What does my pipeline look like right now?
- What’s our win rate for this period?
- What’s due in the next seven days?
- What have I been awarded in the last 60 days?
- Where is my spenddown at risk?


Save your custom views so you never have to rebuild a report.


‍


**Plus, we’re opening the waitlist for Instrumentl's first AI course for grant professionals** . Free and designed to meet GPCI and CFRE standards, it’s built to help you do *better* work with AI, not just *more* work. We’re building it in a way that we hope connects you to your community. There’ll be hand on exercises that you can apply to your actual workflows. And regular live sessions where you can get feedback from your peers.


[Join the waitlist →](https://www.instrumentl.com/ai-for-grant-work-course?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch-blog-post&utm_campaign=summer-launch)


‍


## Why this moment matters


Grant professionals have always been asked to do more with less. What's different now is the complexity of the landscape it's happening in.


The most valuable thing a prospecting tool can do in this moment isn't give you more results. It gives you more confidence: that you're not missing anything, that the opportunities in front of you are worth your time, and that your funding strategy is built on solid ground.


It’s a partner.


[Try for free](https://www.instrumentl.com/signup?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch-blog-post&utm_campaign=summer-launch)
